topic: Number of Players and Court Dimensions
description: This topic provides a factual description of the number of active players in a team and the official dimensions of the playing areas for various competitive sports.

sections.title: Terminology of Sports Grounds
sections.description: The specific playing areas of different sports are known by distinct technical names.

key_concepts.explanation: A playing area with a defined hard surface. Examples: Badminton, Tennis, Basketball, and Volleyball.
A playing area generally made of grass or artificial turf. Examples: Cricket, Rugby, and Football.
A square playing area enclosed by ropes. Examples: Boxing and Wrestling.
A 'Rink' is used for Ice Hockey and Skating, whereas a 'Diamond' is the specific playing area for Baseball.

sections.title: Number of Players in Various Sports
sections.description: The standard number of active players on the field for a single team in various sports.

key_associations.extra_info: Each team consists of 11 active players on the field.
This is the maximum number of players in a single team for any field sport.
Baseball is the national sport of the USA.
In Kabaddi, a team has 7 active players on the court and 5 reserve players.
In Volleyball, the 6 players rotate positions in a clockwise direction.
This sport involves continuous and unlimited substitution of players.
This sport is played on horseback.

sections.title: Major Sports and their Court Dimensions
sections.description: The official length and width of the playing areas for various international sports.

key_associations.extra_info: These are the dimensions for doubles. For singles, the court size is 44 ft × 17 ft.
These are the dimensions for singles. For doubles, the width is increased to 36 ft.
This is the distance between the two sets of wickets. The width of the pitch is 10 ft.
These are the standard dimensions set by the International Basketball Federation (FIBA).
The court is divided into two equal 9m × 9m halves by a center net.

sections.title: Equipment and Net Heights
sections.description: Crucial measurements of nets, goal posts, and specific equipment used in different sports.

important_facts.fact: In Volleyball, the standard net height is 2.43 meters for men and 2.24 meters for women.
In Badminton, the net height is 1.55 meters at the edges and exactly 1.524 meters (5 feet) at the center.
In Cricket, the height of the stumps is 28 inches above the ground, and the official weight of the ball is between 155.9 and 163 grams.
In Basketball, the rim (hoop) is positioned exactly 10 feet (3.05 meters) above the floor.
A standard Table Tennis table has a length of 2.74m, a width of 1.525m, and its playing surface is 76 cm above the floor.

sections.title: Additional Important Facts
sections.description: Other specific and frequently tested facts related to sports grounds and players.

important_facts.fact: The playing field for Polo is the largest among all field sports, measuring approximately 300 yards by 160 yards.
The standard size of a professional Snooker table is 11 ft 8.5 inches by 5 ft 10 inches.
A Golf course does not have standard, fixed dimensions, but a standard round of golf consists of playing 18 holes.
A standard Chess board consists of 64 alternating black and white squares, and each player begins the game with 16 pieces.
